profile.summary: Corovan is a California company that provides commercial moving, storage and workplace services. These include office and business relocations, warehouse storage, and IT and project management. It also moves schools, colleges and universities, including labs, libraries and computer labs. The company says it has been in business for 75 years and is employee-owned.
